device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 on a rented Vast.ai container (instance 60045623, 192 vCPU x86_64 host)

model_config.host_context: Rented Vast.ai container, 2026-11-10; GPU and CPU runs sequential on the same host; one run per size, no warmup; host sharing not measured. Seconds printed with 0.1 ms resolution, converted to ns here.

plan.cpu: research/gpu-gating/dense_cpu.rs: stele_sumcheck::Dense (feature std, rayon pool) on the same tables and challenges; timed from Dense::new to the final values
plan.gpu: research/gpu-gating/dense_gpu.cu: tables device-resident after one pageable cudaMemcpy upload; per round a grid-stride node-sum kernel with a fixed-order block tree, a one-thread-per-node block-order reduction, a device-to-host copy of the K+1 round values (Fiat-Shamir round trip) and a fold kernel; CUDA context created outside the timed region
plan.operation: dense QM31 sumcheck, one product term of K tables (degree K), all rounds and folds
plan.output: FNV-1a 64 over the little-endian bytes of every round value and the final values

projection.flips_if: a stories42M profile on the target host with residual share <= 1/3 of wall time (task E16-22)
projection.gate: GO needs projected end-to-end gain >= 3x; NO-GO otherwise (task E16-21)
projection.method: Amdahl: T' = T * (r + (1 - r) / s). r is the residual CPU share, the main-thread self samples outside the offloaded stages over all main-thread samples; s is the device speedup of the offloaded stages, taken as the measured rounds-only ratio (CPU reference total over GPU rounds) at its lowest and highest, and unbounded.

profile.classifier: research/gpu-gating/stage_shares.py (first matching stage on the stack)
profile.device: arm64 Apple M4 Max, 16 hardware threads, macOS; release build; tree differs from this commit only in agents/tasks/graph.yaml
profile.instrument: macOS sample, 1 ms interval, whole prove-dev process; main thread call tree
profile.parallel_region_rule: a sample is inside a parallel region when a rayon or thread::scope frame is on its stack
profile.scaling: stage shares of the 8-layer fixture applied unchanged to stories42M; not measured on stories42M or on the 24-thread host

unmeasured_biases: attribution: stage_shares.py charges relation_other by the first stage pattern on the stack; field products there that belong to LogUp leaf preparation or dense rounds overstate the residual
threads: the fixture ran on 16 threads and the target on 24; the offloaded stages are mostly parallel and the residual mostly sequential, so more threads raise the residual share
projection.verdict: NO-GO (provisional: fixture stage shares, stories42M unprofiled)

note: E16-21 GPU gating micro-benchmark (RFC-0014 §1, §5; RFC-0026 §7). prover_time_ns is the sum of the GPU totals (upload plus rounds) over the four sizes; stage times are per size. CPU reference times are kernel_counters cpu/*/total_ns. GPU and CPU round values agree byte for byte (FNV). Upload uses pageable host memory. The projection in model_config applies stage shares profiled on the 8-layer fixture to the stories42M record; it is an estimate, not a measurement of a GPU prover. The `standard` schema tag grants no profile admission: micro records cannot carry `development`. Micro schema proof, verifier and control fields are zero because no inference evidence is claimed. The commit is the base the benchmark was built against; stele-sumcheck and stele-field are unchanged from it through the profiled commit. Not a cost-model fit input.
